  THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 13, 2025

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56846  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Marine Advisory Commission
  meeting of Thursday, October 9, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-56848  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from Public Works on the
  history of the Colorado Lagoon Open Channel project.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-56849  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Conservation Corps of
  Long Beach, focusing on environmental programs on young adults assisting with
  the education and projects near the bay, recreational waters, Marinas, Seal Beach
  Naval wetlands and environmental preserve.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-56850  Recommendation to receive and file the Manager's monthly oral updates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-56851  Recommendation to receive and file the Executive and Ad Hoc “Point of Historical
  Interest” Committees status report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.
